metadata.title: TrialSwarm AI — 60-Second Founder Pitch
metadata.audience: Berkeley x DeepMind Hackathon Judges and Oncology Clinical Trial Sponsors.
metadata.intent: Prove clinical trial matching fails on pharmacology and washout traps, and demonstrate how Antigravity /swarm with deterministic verifiers prevents lethal under-triage at zero compute cost.

scene.intent: Hook the viewer with the clinical trial enrollment crisis and lethal AI under-triage.

shot.visual: High-contrast dark canvas (#0D1117). Large amber metric: 86% of oncology trials fail to recruit on time. Red warning card: Naive LLMs miss pharmacology ceilings.
shot.motion: Card slides up with 200ms ease; metric glows amber (#E8A33D).
shot.voiceover: Eighty-six percent of oncology trials fail to recruit on time, while clinical AI matchers hallucinate eligibility and under-triage lethal contraindications.

scene.intent: Demonstrate the exact clinical trap using PT-102 on Dexamethasone.

shot.visual: Split-screen comparison: Patient PT-102 (Marcus Vance, NSCLC). Left box shows Dexamethasone 2 mg BID (4 mg/day). Right box shows Naive LLM output: ELIGIBLE (4 mg <= 10 mg ceiling).
shot.motion: Red pulse on naive ELIGIBLE verdict. Formula badge reveals in amber: Dexamethasone = 6.67x Prednisone.
shot.voiceover: Marcus Vance takes Dexamethasone two milligrams BID. Naive LLMs see four milligrams, check the ten-milligram ceiling, and falsely clear him.

scene.intent: Reveal the Antigravity /swarm multi-agent coordination architecture.

shot.visual: Antigravity /swarm board visualization (docs/workflow.svg). Left-to-right pulse from @coordinator to @extractor and @phenotyper, flowing into @safety-auditor. Rule R1 formula calculates 26.67 mg/day Prednisone equivalent.
shot.motion: Swarm agent nodes light up in parallel sequence (100ms stagger). Formula converts 4 mg * (5/0.75) = 26.67 mg/day.
shot.voiceover: TrialSwarm coordinates five agents on an Antigravity swarm. Extractor and Phenotyper parse protocol and EHR in parallel. Rule R1 converts Dexamethasone to twenty-six point seven milligrams Prednisone equivalent.

scene.intent: Show deterministic Rule R6 line-grounding and CRC sign-off receipt.

shot.visual: Clinical workstation UI: Verdict switches to CONTRAINDICATED with amber badge. @verifier audits line citations (L20 protocol, L26 EHR). SHA-256 sign-off modal stages receipt PKT-NCT04613596-PT-102.
shot.text: Rule R6 Line-Anchored Grounding · SHA-256 Sign-Off
shot.motion: Citation highlight beams connect EHR line 26 to protocol line 20. Green lock icon verifies 100% citation grounding.
shot.voiceover: Verdict: Contraindicated. The Verifier enforces Rule R6: every claim is line-anchored to source text, blocking hallucinations before CRC sign-off.

scene.intent: Summarize benchmark validation and live availability.

shot.visual: Benchmark scorecard card: n = 120, 100.0% accuracy vs 47.5% naive baseline. Compute cost: $0.0000. Live URL displayed: https://ahmedadel7887--trialswarm-ai-web.us-east.modal.run/
shot.motion: Scorecard numbers count up; QR code / live URL fades in smoothly.
shot.voiceover: One hundred percent accuracy on one hundred twenty cases. Zero-cost deterministic compute. Built, shipped, and live.
